purpose: Define the organ responsible for detecting circular organism dependencies and producing bounded mutation proposals with sovereign inference.
invariants: Cycle detection is deterministic and registry-backed.
Sovereign inference may propose mutations but must not directly mutate organism DNA.
Every proposal must declare targets, coord_targets, expected proof, rollback shape, and confidence.
Every proposal that can reach Hermes must also carry a cynic.agent_proposal.v1 envelope for operator interface review.
Organ-lifecycle owns dependency convergence; organ-forge remains release/build executor until transmutation is complete.
Circular dependency updates must be represented as Kernel tasks or observations, never as narrative TODO files.
If inference is unavailable, the organ must still emit deterministic cycle evidence and a blocked proposal request.
loop: build sovereign inference request from bounded JSON context
validate proposal targets and rollback contract
dispatch or observe proposal through Kernel mempool
